three_core_components.name: Orchestrator
three_core_components.role: central coordinator; receives user requests; delegates tasks to specialized Experts via A2A protocol

three_core_components.name: Experts
three_core_components.role: specialized sub-agents that perform domain-specific work; may call external services through MCP

three_core_components.name: Memory
three_core_components.role: maintains persistent context and state; enables Orchestrator to make informed decisions; ensures continuity across conversations

interaction_patterns.name: Request/Response (Polling)
interaction_patterns.use: synchronous APIs; client sends input, waits for single response; for long-running tasks, client polls the task endpoint for status and results

interaction_patterns.name: Streaming with Server-Sent Events (SSE)
interaction_patterns.use: real-time experiences (ambient notes, live guidance); client opens SSE stream; receives incremental tokens, events, status over open HTTP

icoder_mapping_notes.orchestrator: maps to iCoDer CortiLikeOrchestrator / CodingComplianceOrchestrator (Phase 5 Track C)
icoder_mapping_notes.experts: maps to iCoDer Expert Registry (A1B-AE.3) — but note Corti calls Experts 'sub-agents' not 'capabilities'. iCoDer charter uses 'discrete capability' definition; this is a clean-room reframing, not a contradiction.
icoder_mapping_notes.memory: maps to iCoDer Memory Expert + Context (A1B-AE.5)
icoder_mapping_notes.a2a_protocol: iCoDer already supports A2A v0.3 wrapper (Phase 5 Track C); this architecture confirms the protocol's centrality
icoder_mapping_notes.sse_streaming: iCoDer already has SSE at /api/v1/runs/{id}/events (Phase 7 Gate 9)
